subtests.name: Focus navigation starting point should be maintained when focused element is removed.
Focus navigation starting point should be maintained when parent element is removed.
Focus navigation starting point should be maintained when shadow host is removed.
Focus navigation starting point should be maintained when focused button is disabled.
Focus navigation starting point should not change when previous element is removed.
Focus navigation starting point should not change when next element is removed.
Focus navigation starting point should not change when next element is moved with moveBefore.
Focus navigation starting point should not change when previous element is moved with moveBefore.
Focus navigation starting point should not change when previous element gets new children.
Focus navigation starting point should not change when focused element at end of shadow tree is removed.
Focus navigation starting point should stay on element when it is disabled and re-enabled.
Focus navigation starting point should stay on element when it is blurred.
Focus navigation starting point should be maintained when slotted focused element is removed.
Focus navigation starting point should be set when scrolling to fragment (and should not be overwritten when <a> is blurred).
